name: L. YAMAL
bio: Lamine Yamal is a generational footballing prodigy who has taken the world by storm on the right wing for FC Barcelona and the Spanish national team. Blessed with otherworldly dribbling, exceptional composure, and an elite footballing IQ at such a young age, his rapid development into a world-class attacker makes him an unstoppable force and a cornerstone for both club and country.

name: GABRIEL
bio: Gabriel Magalhaes is a rock-solid Brazilian central defender who forms the unbreakable defensive backbone of Arsenal. Renowned for his aggressive aerial dominance, immense physical presence, and superb tactical positioning, he is equally dangerous in the opposition box, frequently chipping in with vital goals from set-pieces during critical campaigns.

name: RICE
bio: Declan Rice is a powerhouse English midfielder who dictates the tempo of the game for Arsenal with world-class ball recovery and driving runs from deep. Combining elite physical endurance with superb tactical intelligence, he screens the defense effortlessly while actively connecting play into the final third, cementing his role as one of the finest midfielders in Europe.

name: VINI JR.
bio: Vinicius Junior is a dynamic Brazilian winger whose explosive acceleration and mesmerizing flair make him a constant nightmare for opposition fullbacks. As Real Madrid's talismanic attacker, his world-class goalscoring instinct and ability to create chances out of nothing have driven his club to multiple domestic and continental titles, establishing him among football's elite superstars.

name: HAKIMI
bio: Achraf Hakimi is a lightning-fast Moroccan right-back who redefines modern flank play for Paris Saint-Germain. Combining incredible top-end speed with lethal crossing and attacking instincts, he transitions seamlessly from defense to offense, providing crucial overlapping runs and defensive stability on the right wing for both club and country.

name: HAALAND
bio: Erling Haaland is a clinical Norwegian striker whose astonishing physical power and lethal finishing instincts make him an unstoppable goalscoring machine for Manchester City. Possessing incredible movement and explosive speed for his height, he routinely shatters goal records in the Premier League and Europe, defining an entire era of modern forward play.

name: OLISE
bio: Michael Olise is a technically gifted French winger who tears opposition defenses apart on the right flank with his mesmerizing close control and elite playmaking vision. Operating as an explosive attacking weapon for Bayern Munich, his exceptional ability to cut inside on his lethal left foot, deliver pinpoint crosses, and execute intricate key passes makes him one of Europe's top talents.

name: KANE
bio: Harry Kane is a world-class English striker playing for Bayern Munich, celebrated for his clinical, multi-faceted finishing and playmaking capability. Serving as a deep-lying forward who creates spaces for teammates while remaining extraordinarily lethal inside the penalty area, his consistent goalscoring record places him among the elite strikers in world football.

name: O. DEMBELE
bio: Ousmane Dembele is an incredibly unpredictable and explosive French attacker for Paris Saint-Germain, possessing genuine two-footed ability that baffles defenders. His terrifying speed, quick-twitch agility, and technical trickery allow him to unlock compact defenses with ease, making him a major offensive focal point in high-intensity European fixtures.

name: SZOBOSZLAI
bio: Dominik Szoboszlai is a dynamic Hungarian attacking midfielder who orchestrates Liverpool's pressing and transitional phases with elite energy. Renowned for his exceptional ball-striking ability from distance, precise set-piece deliveries, and tireless off-the-ball work rate, he provides immense tactical versatility to the Reds' midfield engine.

name: VALVERDE
bio: Federico Valverde is a tireless and versatile Uruguayan midfielder who powers Real Madrid with his extraordinary work rate, tactical flexibility, and blistering speed. Capable of playing centrally or wide, his fierce long-range shooting and relentless box-to-box presence make him a vital asset in transition and big-game scenarios.

name: B. FERNANDES

Renowned for his phenomenal chance creation, audacious vision, and precise passing, he constantly orchestrates attacks from the advanced midfield position, proving to be a highly influential figure on the European stage.

name: PEDRI

His ability to navigate tight spaces, deliver defense-splitting key passes, and control the match rhythm draws comparison to footballing legends, making him a cornerstone of the Blaugrana midfield.

name: BELLINGHAM

Blending immense defensive work rate with a supreme goalscoring touch and tactical maturity beyond his years, he transitions effortlessly into attacking phases, defining the template of the ultimate modern box-to-box superstar.

Celebrated for his elite crossing capability and brilliant left-footed ball delivery, he adapts seamlessly into back-three or wingback setups, providing massive tactical advantages and consistent creation options on the flank.
